'''2002 World Championship Top 8 Brian Terwilliger DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Terwilliger]] at [[2002 World Championship]] (Top 8), finishing 4th; the list below is from the official Players Committee decklist form.<ref name="src">[http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/twiggDS.pdf SWCCG Players Committee decklist form: Hunt Down]</ref>

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Brian Terwilliger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2002 World Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Finish:''' 4th
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Hunt Down
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Source:''' [http://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/decks/twiggDS.pdf PC decklist form]
